defaults.cta_text: WHICH FINAL LOSS HURT MESSI MOST? 👇
visual_evidence_prompts: a real photograph of Lionel Messi
a real photograph of Mario Gotze
defaults.video_script: Three finals. Zero goals. Messi's Argentina played three hundred and sixty minutes without scoring. Two thousand fourteen: Germany won one-nil, Gotze scored in extra time. Two thousand fifteen Copa America final: nil-nil against Chile. Chile won four-one on penalties. Two thousand sixteen, the rematch: nil-nil again. Chile won four-two on penalties, and Messi missed. Messi had scored his own penalty in two thousand fifteen. Which of those three finals hurt Messi most?
defaults.video_subject: Messi's Argentina lost the 2014 World Cup final 1-0 to Germany and the 2015 and 2016 Copa America finals to Chile on penalties after two 0-0 draws, playing 360 minutes across three finals without scoring.
